'''Sanctuary of the Silent Scribes''' is a [[1on1]]/[[2on2]] map created for the [[QHLAN2024]] Prewar tournament, featuring a circular layout around a central building. 

All weapons, the [[YA]] and [[GA]] are placed around the main building's perimeter, with the [[Red Armor]] located in the central chamber for strategic defense.  A hidden crypt beneath the building contains the [[Mega Health]] and a large ammo supply. It is accessed through a shootable bookshelf adjacent to the main chamber.

A distinctive quad mechanic is introduced for [[2on2]] play: The [[quad]] is located at the top of the central chamber, accessible only by teleport. The teleporter is accessed by shooting a specific face in the crypt while standing on one of the tombs. The shootable face has a cooldown time of 2.5 minutes (150 seconds), limiting a ten-minute match to a maximum of four quads.
